Thanks for the breakdown. Quick notes from legal (high level) — I won't redline the whole MSA here but want to be explicit on language to avoid future disputes:

1) Audit/inspection clause: replace vague phrases with: "Customer may request an inspection of Redwood's relevant controls limited to specific systems and time-bounded snapshots. Redwood will provide remote evidence by default and will make reasonable efforts to accommodate on-site inspections subject to prior notice and approval, a maximum of 2 business days on-site, and reimbursement of reasonable travel costs."

2) Notice period & pen-test triggers: accept 30 days' notice for non-emergency audits. For pen tests, propose: "Customer may request a penetration test on a staging environment with at least 45 days' notice and subject to a mutually agreed safe-harbor and scope doc. Production pen tests require Redwood approval and coordination; Redwood will provide a staging environment that mirrors production for security testing."

3) Evidence cadence: suggest we commit to providing the latest SOC 2 Type II report within 10 business days of request (after NDA) and annual update posting to a secured customer portal. For customers who need continuous evidence, propose a quarterly snapshot package (summary logs + configuration artifacts) on request subject to a minimal admin fee — recommended for enterprise/legal only.

4) Restrict scope: include an exhibit that lists the systems/components in-scope for SOC 2 and pen tests (e.g., inference runtime, control plane, customer data separation, but exclude internal developer workstations and third-party SaaS integrations unless separately scoped).

Please review and tell me which items you want me to draft into explicit MSA exhibit language. Neha — can you confirm what we can deliver for the quarterly snapshot and what requires engineering time? Karthik — confirm whether staging environment parity is feasible and timeline for creating a disposable test environment.

One-liners from Neha (threaded inline):
> Neha: We can definitely provide the SOC 2 Type II pdf and assertion letter. Quarterly snapshots are possible but will require a minimal ops run (~2 engineer-days per quarter) to gather sanitized logs and ensure PII is removed. I'll outline which artifacts are automated vs. manual.

Laura
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Maya — thanks for the redlines & the patience. Appreciate the narrow asks — we think this is workable without re-opening the MSA broadly. Summary of what we can commit to and next steps: 

1) Evidence & SOC2: Redwood will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (pdf + assertion letter) within 10 business days of a formal request and NDA. We will also offer a quarterly snapshot package (sanitized logs + change history + configuration snapshot) for customers who request ongoing assurance; this will incur a small admin fee to cover ops time. Neha will send the SOC2 evidence matrix by EOD Tuesday to show exact artifacts and redaction guidance.

2) Pen tests & inspection windows: We accept a staged approach — remote evidence exchange by default. For customer-led penetration testing, Redwood will provide a staging environment. We propose a 45-day notice for staging pen tests (to allow environment provisioning and runbook review) and retain approval for any production-facing tests. For on-site inspections, we will agree to a maximum 2 business day window and a 30-day notice for non-emergency audits. Karthik will follow up with a short tech note on staging parity and access steps.

3) MSA exhibit language: Laura will produce a succinct exhibit that (a) lists in-scope systems/components, (b) sets the notice windows, and (c) describes the evidence cadence and delivery method (secured portal + email for initial delivery). We'll avoid broad unconditional inspection rights.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 2028-05-16: Neha sends SOC2 evidence matrix (by EOD) — DONE (attached).
- Wed 2028-05-17: Laura to draft exhibit language and pass to ClearSight legal for 1 round of comments.
- Fri 2028-05-19: Karthik to provide staging environment parity note and pen-test runbook.
- Mon 2028-05-22: Redwood to deliver consolidated response + redline for the exhibit.

If that works, I'll send a short consolidated response + the proposed exhibit redline as a PDF and schedule a 30-minute call to walk through. Would morning PT on Tue 2028-05-23 work for you?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
